payload.query:
subscription MapVisualisationSubscribeToMedia3DShots(
    $input: SubscribeToGolfTeamMedia3DShotsInput!
  ) {
    subscribeToGolfMedia3DShots(input: $input) {
      __typename
      x
      y
      z
      addressing
      provisionalIndex
      ballHoled
      isApproximate
      strokeNo
      holeNo
      surfaceTypeCode
      teamId
      courseId
      seqNum
      isBallDrop
      isProvisional
      isProvisionalSelected
      shotDistance
      score
      distanceToPin
      player {
        id
      }
    }
  }
